name: public-data
protects: Credentials and private contacts stay out of the public repository
why: R-REPO-01: public git history cannot retract a leak
runs: npm run validate; PR and main CI

name: local-only
protects: Papers never enter analytics, remote APIs or an unapproved SDK
why: R-KID-01 and R-PRV-06: children's and medical records stay on the phone
runs: npm run validate; PR and main CI

name: honest-claims
protects: App, store and website copy (EN and ES) cannot advertise prohibited security or legal outcomes or use race-labelled branding; app and store copy never names a competitor
why: R-ADV-01/02 unsupported claims; R-REPO-06 competitor names never in store metadata (website allowed); spec: no race-labelled app, store or web page
runs: npm run validate; PR and main CI

name: preview-screens
protects: Every app screen has a screenshot step in the simulator preview flow (or a stated reason it cannot be reached), so the owner sees each screen before store accounts are paid
why: Owner ruling 2 Nov 2026: she must see every build; a new screen without a preview step would ship unseen
runs: npm run validate; PR and main CI
